en-US.name: Brainstorming
en-US.summary: Clarify requirements, propose a design and get approval before implementing. The optional browser visual companion needs Node.js; by default its page loads an upstream logo tagged with a version string (telemetry), which an environment variable turns off.

zh-CN.name: 动手前先头脑风暴
zh-CN.summary: 实现前先澄清需求、给出设计并获得确认。可选的浏览器可视化助手需 Node.js；其页面默认从上游网站加载带版本号的徽标（遥测），可用环境变量关闭。

requirements.value: Optional browser visual companion only: an operator-installed Node.js runs the bundled scripts/server.cjs, bound to 127.0.0.1 on a random high port and gated by a per-session key. Screens are written under the project's .superpowers/brainstorm/ (or /tmp), and the browser is opened only after the user accepts the companion. The text-only workflow needs no runtime.

By default the visual companion page loads a logo from primeradiant.com with a version string in the URL; upstream documents this as usage telemetry that sends no project data. Setting SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY, DISABLE_TELEMETRY or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC removes it. DesireCore does not operate this endpoint.
